clues: This capital city sits in Galicia, in the northwest of Spain. Picture the top left corner of the map of Spain.
Winters here are mild, but the rain is heavy. Atlantic storm winds push that rain in from the ocean.
This city began with a shrine to Saint James the Great. Pilgrims have walked here since the 9th century.
Its old town is so special that UNESCO protects it. It joined the World Heritage list in 1985.
Its grand cathedral is the end of the Way of Saint James. Walkers finish their journey at this famous church.
